description: This file defines a final utility class ClientResourceMapper that provides static methods to convert between Client and ClientResource objects, functioning as a data mapper within the application's REST layer.

classes.name: ClientResourceMapper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to map between ClientResource and Client domain model objects.

methods.name: mapToClient
methods.description: Converts a ClientResource object into a Client domain model object by mapping fields and nested project resources.

methods.name: mapToClientResource
methods.description: Converts a Client domain model object into a ClientResource object suitable for REST responses.
